WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    b.link_to_event, 
    e.status, 
    AVG(b.remaining) as avg_remaining,
    AVG((b.spent - b.amount) / CAST(NULLIF(b.amount, 0) AS REAL)) as avg_ratio
  FROM budget b 
  JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id 
  GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.status
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    status, 
    AVG(avg_remaining) as avg_remaining_by_status, 
    AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_ratio_by_status
  FROM step1 
  GROUP BY status
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) as overall_avg_remaining
  FROM step1
)
SELECT 
  s2.status,
  s2.avg_remaining_by_status,
  s2.avg_ratio_by_status,
  s2.avg_remaining_by_status / s3.overall_avg_remaining as ratio_to_overall
FROM step2 s2
CROSS JOIN step3 s3
WHERE s3.overall_avg_remaining IS NOT NULL
